request.subject: UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Change only the face: it becomes a living gaunt old man's face with pale grey-white skin, dark veins round the eyes, one dark eye and one milky white eye, a nose and a thin cruel mouth, clearly human and not a skull. Do not redraw anything else: keep the tall red cowl, the black, red and gold robe, the bloody steel dagger, the chain, the thick black outline and the art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
